listing.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force — Tag Force Recomp (Artknighty)
listing.summary: This is an early public preview. The project claims start-to-finish story, field, dialogue, duels, DeckEdit, shop, saves, audio and video, mainly on one machine, version and save. Network and ad-hoc play are unavailable. Game logic runs at 30 FPS; 60/120 FPS presentation interpolation is experimental. APIs, formats, settings and folders may change. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own European ULES00600 v1.01 ISO; installed assets and generated C/jitcache kept locally. ISO is needed at installation, not after import.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Select plain TagForceRecomp-<version>-win64.zip, which README identifies as runtime/translator/TinyCC/FFmpeg without mods or textures. Install and Play imports own EUISO and locally translates/compiles into gen/jitcache; later Play no ISO is needed. Mods/EnhancedTextures/Fullsplitpacks are separate optional downloads, not default selected payload.

warnings: This is an early public preview. The project claims start-to-finish story, field, dialogue, duels, DeckEdit, shop, saves, audio and video, mainly on one machine, version and save. Network and ad-hoc play are unavailable. Game logic runs at 30 FPS; 60/120 FPS presentation interpolation is experimental. APIs, formats, settings and folders may change.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
